fact: Bayobab completed a fibre optic network linking Mombasa in Kenya to Kampala in Uganda in May 2025, per Connecting Africa.
Connecting Africa reports that in May 2025 Bayobab completed a fibre optic network linking Mombasa in Kenya to Kampala in Uganda.

Africa50 and Bayobab partnered in May 2023 to co-develop Project East2West, a roughly USD 320 million terrestrial fibre network that names Uganda among the countries covered; the document gives no start of works.
